proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the source-key filter separate (2/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

Only add an original to the orphan set when it is a single key, but leave valid shortcut outputs eligible for `targetKeys` below. This keeps the source-key set separate from single-key output reachability and preserves the existing `Alone` exception.

```suggestion
                if (hasSingleKeyOriginal && mapping.Condition != SingleKeyRemapCondition.Alone)
```

Apply all three parts together using **Add suggestion to batch**, then **Commit suggestions**.
